svg.title: Measure the coated-sphere PL decay
svg.desc: Measure the coated-sphere PL decay. Repetition interval is chosen to permit complete decay before the next pulse. Concentration, dilution, beam area and acquisition duration are not reported. Conceptual source operation. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned.
svg.text: excitation wavelength: 405 nm; laser power: 130 mW; repetition rate: 1 MHz; pulse interval: 1000 ns;
Repetition interval is chosen to permit complete decay before the next pulse. Concentration, dilution, beam
area and acquisition duration are not reported.
Atmosphere: not reported for this operation.
Conceptual source operation. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned.
